'''March 2001 Rochester tournament (31 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, NY on 31 March 2001. [[R. Smith]] won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1991">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-punching-in-roche-ny-3-31d1991/ punching-in-roche-ny-3-31], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 1 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-punching-in-roche-ny-3-31d1991/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 31 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[R. Smith]]
